# The Signal Room with Chris Hutchins

> Healthcare AI podcast covering governance, data strategy, and responsible implementation.

## Public resources
- [Episodes](https://signalroompodcast.com/episodes): Episode pages, notes, and available transcripts.
- [About](https://signalroompodcast.com/about): About the show and host.
- [Guests](https://signalroompodcast.com/guests): Podcast guests.
- [Contact](https://signalroompodcast.com/contact): Contact and guest inquiries.
- [Privacy](https://signalroompodcast.com/privacy): Existing privacy policy.
- [Sitemap](https://signalroompodcast.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs.
- [API catalog](https://signalroompodcast.com/.well-known/api-catalog): Public machine-readable resources.

## Reading guidance
Request the homepage with Accept: text/markdown for its text representation. Cite canonical episode URLs and distinguish guest statements from the host's statements. Public reading requires no authentication. Guest applications and purchases require human action.

## Agent protocols
- MCP: https://signalroompodcast.com/mcp (public resources; Streamable HTTP).
- A2A: https://signalroompodcast.com/a2a (JSON-RPC 0.3.0; public resource directory).
- Agent card: https://signalroompodcast.com/.well-known/agent-card.json

These read-only services require no authentication. No OAuth authorization server or OAuth-protected resource is offered. MCP Server Card discovery is experimental.
